models_evaluated: BiomedBERT extraction pipeline with deterministic clinical engine

links.outcome: Exact ESI triage accuracy of competing large commercial models versus specialized small-model pipeline on same cases
links.effect: Off-the-shelf large models reached 45–55% exact ESI accuracy; BiomedBERT pipeline reached 88.9% exact and 97.2% adjacent accuracy on a 50-case set.
links.quote: Off-the-shelf large models achieve only 45–55% exact ESI accuracy while being impractical for clinical deployment due to privacy constraints, cost, and latency.

unlisted_practices: Structured chain-of-thought supervision and reinforcement learning with a clinically asymmetric reward function

screen.reason: Evaluates commercial LLMs and specialized small language models/BERT pipelines on ESI triage prediction benchmark datasets; does not test a health system deployment practice or operational safeguard.
